mode.description: given: weights are operator-set and stored verbatim by fit. search: fit proposes non-negative weights via a constrained linear fit.

weights.description: Feature name (post-preprocessing output column) → weight. Required in given mode.

missing_data_policy.description: Per-input policy for absent evidence (Exclude requires the presence mask).

class_threshold.description: Classification cut on the scaled score (default midpoint).
